name: digibank Live Fresh

memberLevels.name: Qualified and claimed
memberLevels.condition: Five offline transactions made this month, of any size, and the monthly claim sent by SMS to 99333

memberLevels.name: Not qualified or not claimed
memberLevels.condition: Fewer than five offline transactions, or the SMS claim not sent, so the month pays nothing

welcomeBonus: Paid for spending at least Rp 1.000.000 within 60 days of approval.
notes: Five per cent back on online spending, capped at Rp 300.000 a month on the main card and Rp 200.000 on a supplementary one. Only the main card’s ceiling is written here; a household running both should raise it by hand.

The cashback has to be earned twice over. Five offline transactions of any size in the month, and then a claim sent by SMS to 99333 as DBS Livefresh#DDMMYY#last four digits. Forget either and the month pays nothing at all, which is why the two states are member levels rather than a footnote. Set the level for the month you are looking at.
Nothing is written for offline spending, because offline spending earns nothing: the five transactions are a hurdle, not a rate.

"Online" is matched by merchant name, from a list of the marketplaces, travel sites, ride-hailing apps and subscriptions people in Indonesia actually use. It is a guess at a category the statement does not label, so an online shop outside the list earns nothing in the estimate, and a bricks-and-mortar branch of a listed name earns when it should not.
The annual fee is Rp 400.000, free for the first year.

DBS changed earning and benefits across its cards on 1 April 2026. What that did to this card was not published in anything reachable from here, so the entry runs one set of terms throughout and a later cycle may be wrong.

No source could be read directly: dbs.id, its RIPLAY and PinterPoin are all unreachable from here, so every figure comes from search summaries. The Rp 300.000 ceiling and the five-transaction rule are corroborated by two independent ones.
